name: HTTP POST Operation
description: Performs an HTTP POST request using the HTTPAdapter

url.description: The URL to make a POST request to

headers.description: HTTP headers to include in the request

queryParams.description: Optional query parameters to append to the URL

bearerSecret.description: Optional reference to a secret (e.g. 's/MY_TOKEN') resolved from the caller's secret store and sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. For a plaintext bearer token, set the Authorization header directly via 'headers' instead.

secretHeaders.description: Optional map of HTTP header name to secret reference. Each resolved secret is used as the complete header value, so store values such as 'Basic <base64>' or the API key itself. Resolved headers override matching literal headers and this entire field is redacted from job records.

status.description: HTTP status code from the response

body.description: The response body from the HTTP request
